tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: Products of a category and of all its subcategories, alphabetically, up to 20 per page.

tools.name: cart_link
tools.description: Prepares ordering for chosen items: one product page link per item, the quantity rules and whether the published count covers the quantity. It does NOT fill a cart (prefilled_cart is always false): the customer opens the link, enters the quantity and checks out on the store site. This server takes n

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Availability of one or more SKUs with the meaning of each state: in stock with a real count, available with unknown quantity, ordered from the supplier with a lead time, made to order, assembled to order, out of stock, not for sale.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side attributes, price, availability, dimensions and weight of 2 to 10 SKUs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything the store publishes about one product by SKU: description, attributes, finish and grade, dimensions and weight with units, order multiples, availability state with its meaning, lead time, images, documents, categories and the product page link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category tree of the store: top level without parent_id, children with parent_id. Use the id in search_products or browse_category.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text search of the store catalog by words, SKU, brand or part number. Returns up to 20 matches with price, availability state and the product page link. For one person's question, not for copying the catalog. Use orderable_only=true to skip items that cannot be bought now.

tools.name: store_policies
tools.description: Shipping, free shipping, freight, returns, refunds, warranty, payment and contact rules of the store in plain text, with links to the full pages.
